name: 95120 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95120 (San Jose) has 193 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95120 (San Jose) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
